spells.name: OffoDefo
spells.description: A small mossy stone coalesces, jabs forward, then returns as protective stone plates.
notes: FX only, with no Wizard or Golem body.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; rightward jab 8–11; returning shield plates 12–15.
The shield follow-through belongs around the caster; any future scene playback should move that phase from the opponent back to the caster.
Current rule: deal 5 damage and gain 5 Shield;7+ gives 5 additional Shield. No mechanical changes.

spells.name: Bengal Shield
spells.description: Layered mossy stone slabs assemble into a broad shield; a tiny violet Mana glint appears before the stone-flake fade.
notes: FX only; compatible with either Wizard or Golem form.
Formation 0–3; clean shield hold 4–7; optional Mana flourish 8–11; disassembly 12–15.
Current rule: gain 10 Shield;6+ grants 1 Mana. The violet flourish is conditional in any future implementation.

spells.name: Earthbound
spells.description: A low ridge charges into a forward stone wave, then rises into a compact three-slab rampart.
notes: FX only, no caster body or fixed landscape.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; rightward ground wave 8–11; conditional rampart 12–15.
Current rule: deal 5 damage;7+ gains 12 Shield. Future playback attaches the conditional rampart to the caster.

spells.name: Merciful
spells.description: Three mossy stone fragments assemble around an empty caster space, orbit through eight distinct poses, then scatter and fade.
notes: FX only; compatible with both Wizard and Golem bodies.
Formation 0–3; persistent loop 4–11; fade 12–15.
Base spell grants 3 Shield. Persistence is eligible only on 6+.
On the qualifying result, fragments persist until the END OF THE OPPONENT’S NEXT TURN, not the end of the current turn.
Duration indicator for the current incoming-damage-bypasses-Shield rule, not the former Golem-protection mechanic.
Review-only animation must simulate expiry; no live-game timing is installed.

spells.name: Tectonic
spells.description: A detached stone-fist effect assembles, charges, slams into a travelling crack, then shatters into dust.
notes: FX only, with no complete Golem body.
Formation 0–3; hold 4–7; slam and travelling crack 8–11; shatter/fade 12–15.
Valid only while Golem is active; current rule deals 15 damage. This spell is separate from the automatic Golem end-turn strike.

spells.name: Fortune
spells.description: A gold luck star rises and twinkles above the rolled dice after Fortune is played.
notes: One clean pixel glyph per Fate; the review player animates its rise, twinkle and fade over 0.6 seconds.
Play after this Fate card is used and before the primary spell resolves.
No wizard animation or change to Fate response priority.

spells.name: Heatbox
spells.description: A faceted firestone pulses and contracts while ember motes gather back into its core.
spells.notes: Effects-only draft atlas: no wizard/body/hat. Artwork is generated PNG bytes without image processing. Use exact proportional cell boundaries; source size can have half-pixel cell divisions. Keep existing caster source and game rules. One-second charge uses two loops of frames4–7. Quick attack impact is320ms. Preview parameters are draft choreography, not runtime integration.

conditional.visual: Ember count should follow resolved gain1/2/3; atlas orbit particles are decorative only.

spells.notes: Effects-only atlas: existing caster can remain fixed and the projectile can move in either direction by mirroring. Additional Flow is conditional on the resolved 8+ result; it is not awarded by this preview.

spells.name: Swell
spells.description: A circular pool gathers beneath the caster and a foaming ocean crest curls around an empty center, shedding Mana glints and water motes.
spells.notes: Clean transparent revision replaces an unused first draft with a white matte. Empty ring centers are transparent for a future caster overlay. Mana gain is on cast; the extra Flow is only for a resolved 7+ result. No live rule or artwork is changed.

spells.name: Carbonate
spells.description: A cyan jellyfish-shaped energy pulse gathers within coral currents, streams forward with curling tentacles, then bursts into a foamy splash.

conditionalEffects.effect: A brief healing pulse returns to the caster only when the resolved roll qualifies; the permanent attack atlas contains no unconditional heart icon.

spells.notes: Uses the current jellyfish/coral illustration motif. Renamed for this review only; stable Water-12 identity and current 3 Mana, 12 + 2 × Flow damage, 7+ heal 2 HP per Flow are recorded without changing live game data.

spells.name: Poseidon's Rift
spells.description: A golden trident rises from a pounding whirlpool, tilts into a powerful forward rush, and detonates into forked water and gold fragments.
spells.notes: Effects-only heavy spell atlas, mirror for the opposite seat. Current 6 Mana cost and printed Flow-scaled damage remain unchanged.
